scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic: exact equicorrelation inverse/eigenvalue formulas, the classical Gaussian-sign arcsine identity, a one-variable monotonicity calculation, and a covariance lower bound for any moment-generating-function proxy. Prior upper bounds and the closest compound-symmetric sign literature are explicitly distinguished.
scientific_limitations: The extremal statement is restricted to positive equicorrelation at fixed coordinate condition number. The covariance lower bound is not asserted to equal the exact optimal sub-Gaussian proxy, and no global extremality over arbitrary covariance matrices is claimed.
title: Diffuse equicorrelation is extremal for Gaussian sign concentration at fixed coordinate condition number
